Practised making 10 with different number pairs.
Found partners for 10 in 3 attempts without help.
Listed different pairs that make 10 in 2 attempts without help.
Initially focused only on 5+5; later connected 7+3 and 4+6 using fingers.
Teach-back was not passed; the final response asked to use the frame.
end.parentNote: Asha practised making 10 by moving one finger from one group of 5 to the other. Gauri used this method to connect 7+3 and 4+6 with 10, after initially repeating that only 5+5 worked. The mix-up about other pairs was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, show 5 fingers and move one at a time to make pairs such as 4+6, 3+7, and 2+8.
